title: Detecting and Mitigating Query-Based System Prompt Leakage Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2610.36295v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on proprietary system prompts to enforce task directives, safety policies, and access controls. These prompts are vulnerable to query-based leakage attacks, where black-box adversaries extract confidential instructions through adaptive, multi-turn interactions. Existing defenses often assess queries independently, missing malicious behavior that emerges across interactions.   We present AdvGuard, a model-agnostic framework for detecting and mitigating system prompt leakage. AdvGuard models cross-query relationships using a bounded semantic interaction graph, statistically filters candidate components, and converts them into line graphs for graph convolutional network (GCN) classification. This approach captures multi-hop patterns in query similarity that distinguish coordinated extraction from benign workflows. translated_title: 检测与缓解基于查询的系统提示词泄露攻击
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）依赖专有的系统提示词来执行任务指令、安全策略和访问控制。这些提示词容易受到基于查询的泄露攻击，即黑盒攻击者通过自适应的多轮交互提取机密指令。现有防御通常独立评估每条查询，无法捕捉跨交互中才显现的恶意行为。我们提出了AdvGuard，一个用于检测和缓解系统提示词泄露的模型无关框架。AdvGuard利用有界语义交互图对跨查询关系进行建模，通过统计方法过滤候选组件，并将其转换为线图以进行图卷积网络（GCN）分类。该方法能够捕捉查询相似性中的多跳模式，从而将协调式的机密提取行为与良性工作流区分开来。轻量级的提示词级检测器能够在交互历史尚不充分时便提供保护。
tldr: 提出了模型无关的AdvGuard框架，通过有界语义交互图建模跨查询关系并利用图卷积网络捕捉多跳模式，实现对基于查询的系统提示词泄露攻击的有效检测与缓解。
en_tdlr: AdvGuard is a model-agnostic framework that detects and mitigates query-based system prompt leakage attacks by modeling cross-query relationships with bounded semantic interaction graphs and using GCN classification to capture multi-hop patterns distinguishing coordinated extraction from benign workflows.
